content.title: Your Guide to the Hottest Parties and Events Happening During 2026 Coachella Weekend
content.text: Neon Carnival in April 2024. Credit : Gilbert Flores/WWD via Getty NEED TO KNOW Coachella Music and Arts Festival 2026 will take place over two weekends: April 10–12 and April 17–19The biggest stars will head to the desert for the festival and beyond, including VIP parties and exclusive eventsPast attendees have included Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce, Justin and Hailey Bieber, Leonardo DiCaprio, Jared Leto, Kendall and Kylie Jenner, among many others Coachella 2026 is bringing the heat! Just when you thought the desert couldn't get any hotter, the parties and events taking place throughout the three-day music and arts festival will raise the temperature tenfold when Weekend 1 kicks off on Friday, April 10. Popping up in various locations across California's Greater Palm Springs area — primarily Indio, Palm Springs and Thermal — the music-filled, beat-bumping bashes keep the days and nights pulsing until the festival wraps on Sunday, April 12. Events that have become synonymous with Coachella weekend are making their highly anticipated returns, including Revolve Festival entering its ninth year and Neon Carnival celebrating its 15th anniversary. NYLON House and Desert Nights, too, are throwing down in the desert once again. While there are several experiences open to the public, many of the private parties are invite-only and boast curated guest lists of A-list stars, tastemakers, creators and varying talent across sports and entertainment. Attendees who've been spotted out and about in years past have included Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce, Justin and Hailey Bieber, Rihanna, Leonardo DiCaprio, Kendall and Kylie Jenner, Alix Earle and more. Topping off a stacked list of diverse performers to hit the Coachella stage across each of its three nights both weekends are headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Bieber and Karol G, while artists like Diplo, David Guetta, Afrojack and Xandra will keep the energy going outside of the festival grounds. Now, read on for a list of the hottest parties and events taking place throughout Coachella 2026 Weekend 1! THURSDAY, April 9 YSL Beauty x Drive-Thru Experience & Beauty Stage Event Palm Springs, California. Allard Schager/Getty YSL Beauty is kicking the fashion-filled weekend off right on Thursday, April 9. For one day only, a classic roadside pitstop will be transformed into a desert beauty destination, inviting guests to cruise through the brand's universe of color, glow and artistry through a series of interactive touch points. As the desert sun begins to set, the space will transition into an exclusive after-hours celebration with cocktails and special appearances from YSL Beauty ambassadors and voices of the brand. Plus, a surprise performance will electrify the night. Related Stories CARAVANA 15-Year Celebration CARAVANA will celebrate 15 years with a private, sunset celebration in the California desert on Thursday, April 9. Friends of the Tulum-based fashion brand, artists and more invitees will gather for an evening shaped by Mexican hospitality, serene surroundings and dancing after dark. Medicube Glow Oasis Pool Party Global K-beauty brand Medicube delivered a glowing night of music, beauty, and unforgettable moments under the desert sky on Thursday, April 9 at their off-sight Glowtel. Medicube also arranged an activation on festival grounds that spotlighted its new skincare device, the Booster Pro. FRIDAY, April 10 Sabrina's Pit Stop Sabrina Carpenter. Kevin Mazur/Getty Airbnb and Sabrina Carpenter are joining forces to bring fans the ultimate vibe-setting and energy-resetting "pit stop" in the desert just off Route 111. Inspired by the Coachella headliner herself, the stop is a Sabrina fantasy land, with sparkly vintage cars, slushie concoctions and much more. "This is a full circle moment for me. I wouldn't be here without my fans so I wanted to create something special just for them. It's not your typical pit stop – I wanted it to feel like a surrealist fantasy land of mine," said Carpenter in the press release. Sabrina's Pit Stop will be open to the public during designated hours: Friday, April 10 (12 p.m.–8 p.m.), Saturday, April 11 (11 a.m.–1 p.m.) and Sunday, April 12 (12 p.m.–3 p.m.). Plus, bookable Airbnb Experiences will offer super fans early entrance for a more intimate experience. Desert Nights x PATRON David Guetta performs in Miami Beach in December 2025. John Parra/Getty PATRÓN Tequila returns to Desert Nights as the exclusive tequila sponsor of the invite-only event, bringing the premium flavor and unmatched energy to a curated guest list for another epic year across the festival's three nights. David Guetta, Afrojack, Green Velvet and more artists will provide the beats at the event, hosted by Corso Millner Group and Framework, keeping the party — and vibes! — going from Friday, April 10 to Sunday, April 12. The Hideout by Soho House Soho House is once again bringing its signature members' club to the desert with The Hideout at Coachella, an exclusive pop-up just steps from the main stage open from 1 p.m. to 1 a.m. throughout the festival's three-day stretch during both weekends. The space will offer a stylish retreat with lounge seating, dining tables, a bespoke bar and a custom DJ booth. NYLON House Diplo performs in New York City in June 2023. ANGELA WEISS/AFP via Getty NYLON will host the return of NYLON House in the Desert in Coachella Valley to mark the unofficial kickoff to the biggest festival celebration in music on Friday, April 10. The evening event, presented by Matrix, will feature a star-studded guest list and a rad DJ set by Diplo B2B HUGEL. The theme this year is NOCTURNA, boasting a fashion-forward, after-dark experience in the desert that will invite partygoers to be inspired by moonlit rituals and the untamed energy of the wild. Music and movement take over the dance floor! Absolut Heat Haus Absolut returns as the festival's official vodka this year, following up last year's House of Cosmo, where Paris Hilton helped ring in the weekend's festivities as the brand's Partner-in-Cosmo. This year, Absolut will celebrate with the introduction of its new Absolut Heat Haus. Open across all three days of the festival, the pop-up will be a high-energy space featuring bold visuals, photo-ready moments and surprise guest DJs spinning throughout the weekend. A menu of festival-themed cocktails will be available too, including the Absolut Spicy Lemonade, Piña Picante Vodkarita and Sun Goddess Spritz. Paris Hilton at Absolut vodka's House of Cosmo at Coachella 2025. Marissa Joy Heineken House The incomparable sips and sounds are returning to the festival scene with Heineken House, where refreshing beverages and great music collide! This year, the space will debut The Clinker: a one-of-a-kind wearable for your beer, which instantly analyzes personal music tastes when toasting with a new friend. Heineken House also boasts its own lineup throughout Coachella's two-weekend stretch: Weekend 1 (April 10–12): Friday: Wale, Robin Schulz, Zerb, Kryptogram, Sander KleinenbergSaturday: Sean Paul, Coi Leray, Andruss, Joshwa, Niiko X Swae, REDKESunday: Motion City Soundtrack, Less Than Jake, Nimino, Oskar Med K, Mild Minds Weekend 2 (April 17–19): Friday: Wale, Robin Schulz, Zerb, Kryptogram, Sander KleinenbergSaturday: Big Boi, Coi Leray, Andruss, Joshwa, Niiko X Swae, REDKESunday: Motion City Soundtrack, Less Than Jake, Nimino, Oskar Med K, Mild Minds Aguachella will kick off Coachella weekend Weekend 1 with a private party featuring all house attendees and VIP guests on Friday, April 10 from 2–5 p.m. PT. The event, brought to you by Agua De Kefir, will also have a DJ set by Love Island alum DJ Nic Vans (aka Nic Vansteenberghe, runner-up from season 7!). This event is private and invite-only, bringing all the island vibes to the desert! SATURDAY, April 11 Revolve Festival Alix Earle attends Revolve Festival in Thermal in April 2025. Vivien Killilea/Getty Revolve Festival is back for its ninth year with its signature mix of music, fashion and culture, bringing together some of the biggest names in entertainment and social media on Saturday, April 11. This year's theme, "The Grand Revivre," channels the magic of a vintage carnival, with playful games, immersive design and photo-ready moments alongside standout live performances. Headliners include Don Toliver, Mustard and Kehlani with additional surprises throughout the night. Rhode Hailey Bieber attends the Rhode UK launch party. Dave Benett/Getty The world of Rhode is activating in the desert! For the first time ever, Hailey Bieber's award-winning line of curated high-performance skincare and beauty essentials are coming to the desert during Weekend 1 for a private event on Saturday, April 11. It will bring together festival-goers and friends of the brand to celebrate their new collaboration, rhode x the Biebers, which features three new products designed with Justin Bieber. Guests will enjoy hands-on activities and live music from DJs Hank Korsan, Josh Conway and Coco & Breezy. Neon Carnival Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce at Neon Carnival in Thermal in April 2024. Gilbert Flores/WWD via Getty Images Neon Carnival hits a major milestone this year, celebrating 15 years as one of the festival weekend's most exclusive, invite-only parties known for attracting A-list stars (hey Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce! hi Justin Bieber! hello Leonardo DiCaprio!), top-tier DJs and standout brand collaborations for a one-night desert takeover. What started as a low-key insider hang has grown into a full-scale spectacle in the Coachella Valley, complete with carnival rides, immersive activations and surprise performances — cementing its status as a sought-after, culture-shaping event. It all comes to life Weekend 1 on Saturday, April 11. The musical lineup this year is stacked! Performers include Ty Dolla $ign, DJ NITRANE and Dre Sinatra, Channel Tres, Mary Mac and many more star-studded surprises throughout the energy-filled night. Desert Nights x PATRON Afrojack performs in Sao Paulo in October 2024. Mauricio Santana/Getty PATRÓN Tequila returns to Desert Nights as the exclusive tequila sponsor of the invite-only event, bringing the premium flavor and unmatched energy to a curated guest list for another epic year across the festival's three nights. David Guetta, Afrojack, Green Velvet and more artists will provide the beats at the event, hosted by Corso Millner Group and Framework, keeping the party — and vibes! — going from Friday, April 10 to Sunday, April 12. Interscope & Capitol Records Coachella Party Towa Bird and Renee Rapp at the 2025 Interscope and Capitol Records Coachella Party on April 12, 2025. Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty Interscope and Capitol are celebrating 10 years of their annual Coachella party on Saturday, April 11. The invite-only event has become one of the festival's hottest gatherings, drawing top artists from the labels and festival lineup alike. Past guests have included Billie Eilish, Lana Del Rey, Camila Cabello, Zedd, OneRepublic, GloRilla, Machine Gun Kelly, Benny Blanco, KATSEYE and more. Attendees this year will be able to enjoy giveaways and experiences from JD Sports, Trü Frü, KAYALI, Erewhon, FIAT and adidas, crafted drinks from El Tesoro Tequila and Suntory Haku Vodka with -196 Vodka Seltzer and On the Rocks cocktails, plus food provided by Anajak Thai. Absolut Hottest Brunch: Desert Edition in Palm Springs The official festival vodka sponsor is hosting an exclusive brunch on Saturday, April 11, at a nearby luxury villa. Tapping into two of the biggest trends in drinking culture right now, spicy/savory cocktails and the resurgence of the “daycap,” the off-site event is built around the new Absolut® TABASCO™. Expect fiery cocktails and spicy bites — plus a few surprise DJ sets for a daytime experience that's as much about the vibe as the drink in your hand. Camp Poosh by Kourtney Kardashian Camp Poosh by Kourtney Kardashian in April 2023. Marc Patrick/BFA.com/Shutterstock Camp Poosh is returning to the desert! Hosted by Kourtney Kardashian, the invite-only event will feature an immersive gifting experience and a highly anticipated headlining performance within the signature desert atmosphere synonymous with the annual celebration on Saturday, April 11. Sonic Desert hosted by Roland and presented by Coca-Cola Sonic Desert, hosted by Roland and presented by Coca-Cola, is bringing the heat to the desert with hands-on music experiences, lively DJ sets and a full lineup of food and drinks to fuel guests for the marathon weekend. Las Vegas-based artist Matthew Topper will keep the beats bumping throughout the party on Saturday, April 11. Take PEOPLE with you! Subscribe to PEOPLE magazine to get the latest details on celebrity news, exclusive royal updates, how-it-happened true crime stories and more — right to your mailbox. Gallery Media Group's Desert House Xandra Pohl in New York City in September 2024. John Lamparski/Getty Images Escape the desert heat with Gallery Media Group's Desert House, a VIP invite for a day of relaxation at a luxury, private estate (... with a pool and all!). The "Desert Darty" will bring together the hottest creators, tastemakers and trendsetters — plus music by XANDRA — for the party's third year on Saturday, April 11. Goldenvoice Surf Club 2026 Edition Goldenvoice Surf Club returns with a new daytime series at Palm Springs Surf Club, featuring artists like BUNT., Levity, Subtronics, and Gordo. Spanning both Coachella weekends, the four poolside shows blend electronic music with the venue's wave pool, lazy river and open-air amphitheater — creating a unique daytime oasis of surf, sound and hospitality. MOKE International will also be cruising on through, bringing the beach vibe synonymous with the vehicle to the desert scene. SUNDAY, April 12 Goldenvoice Surf Club 2026 Edition Goldenvoice Surf Club outside Coachella. Ava Austin Goldenvoice Surf Club returns with a new daytime series at Palm Springs Surf Club, featuring artists like BUNT., Levity, Subtronics and Gordo. Spanning both Coachella weekends, the four poolside shows blend electronic music with the venue's wave pool, lazy river and open-air amphitheater — creating a unique daytime oasis of surf, sound and hospitality. MOKE International will also be cruising on through, bringing the beach vibe synonymous with the vehicle to the desert scene. Afrobeats Brunch The Martell x Davido Brunch: A Toast to Afrobeats is set to become one of the festival's most coveted experiences hosted within a private estate for guests to unwind and toast to the meteoric rise of the music genre. Invitees will be welcomed with Martell's French 75 while a DJ spins the hottest beats before Davido himself arrives on Sunday, April 12.
